review.notes: Full review. Seeded sample: all 14 sections (1.1-6.2) recomputed, with the 6.2 radii, the Schur matrix diag(1,0) and the product-point feasibility checked by hand; 11 locators read in 6 sources (arXiv texts of Tsuzuku et al., Fazlyab et al. v2, Gowal et al., Wong-Kolter, Zhang et al., Szegedy et al.); Megretski-Rantzer not readable. Gate FAIL (imports, mathlib-subimports, no-import-mathlib, outside-folder), build passes; elaboration of the head and of a copy with the single Mathlib import gives sorry as the only warning; depcheck 0 problems. One-tactic probes close 5 declarations (padding). Blocking: an executable checker in 6.1, the multilayer LipSDP headline neither stated nor named, missing l <= u / 1 <= L hypotheses. Overlap: RandomizedSmoothing, StructuredBlockOperators, SpectralSteepestDescent, Neuromanifolds read; nothing shared.
